name: DL-12 heavy blaster pistol
description: The DL-12 heavy blaster pistol was a model of heavy blaster pistol that was slightly more powerful than a standard heavy blaster. At some point, the bounty hunter brothers Irol and Nevo Faunor each carried a DL-12 heavy blaster pistol on the Mid Rim planet Krykas V while attempting to collect a bounty on Min Erethen, a droid and weapons designer who was stranded on the world.
